title: Jeweled Mask
description: At the start of combat put a random Power from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold], it's free to play.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Triggers at the beginning of round 1 only. Randomly selects one Power card from your Draw Pile and moves it to your Hand without cost.
